passportIndex.note: Top 4 worldwide: 185 destinations, full EU rights, ESTA for the US, and one of the strongest business reputations. From Schiphol, ~82% of the world is reachable without a visa.

dualNationality.note: General rule: voluntarily naturalizing elsewhere means losing Dutch citizenship — but there are broad exceptions (married to a national of that country, born there, or if renouncing is impossible). It's been a political debate for years.
